title: 期权授予契约 Option Award Deed

fields.parties: 甲方：清岑示例公司；乙方：沐序示例公司（均为合成主体）

sections.heading: Grant 授予
sections.body: Award date: to be recorded. Number and exercise price: to be supplied. 授予日、数量、币种及行权价由实际契约填写。

sections.heading: Vesting and exercise 归属与行权
sections.body: Vesting schedule and conditions are recorded separately. 归属、行权、窗口和届满条款分别记录，不从时间经过自动推算归属。

sections.heading: Execution 签署
sections.body: Company signatory: ________; Participant: ________. 公司与激励对象签署及实际签署日期分别保留。
